identificationModule.officialTitle: Evaluation of Safety and Efficacy of CD19 CAR-T Consolidation Therapy for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Concomitant With Infusion of CD19+T Cells as Feeding Cells

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase1 Incidence of adverse events (AEs) and abnormal laboratory test results
primaryOutcomes.description: AEs will be assessed according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events 5.0 (CTCAE5.0).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months after CD19 CAR-T consolidation therapy termination

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 2 Molecular response after CD19 CAR-T consolidation therapy for acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia concomitant with infusion of feeding Cells.
primaryOutcomes.description: Complete molecular response (CMR) was defined as the absence of a detectable BCR-ABL1 transcript with a sensitivity of 0.01%.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 3 months after CD19 CAR-T consolidation therapy termination

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 Molecular response after CD19 CAR-T consolidation therapy for acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia concomitant with infusion of feeding Cells.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Complete molecular response (CMR) was defined as the absence of a detectable BCR-ABL1 transcript with a sensitivity of 0.01%.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 3 months after CD19 CAR-T consolidation therapy termination

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 The range of biologically active doses and optimal biological doses of feeding T cells.
secondaryOutcomes.description: The range of biologically active doses and optimal biological doses of feeding T cells will be determined.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months after CD19 CAR-T consolidation therapy termination

secondaryOutcomes.description: It is measured from the date of entry into this trial to the date of death from any cause; patients not known to have died at last follow-up are censored on the date they were last known to be alive.

It is measured from the date of achievement of a remission until the date of relapse from CR, or CRi, or death from any cause; patients not known to have any of these events are censored on the date they were last examined.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ph+ acute B-lymphoblastic leukemia patients having received once CD19 CAR-T therapy
* continuously taking TKI medications
* no chance to receive allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
* no severe complications
* ECOG score less than 3

Exclusion Criteria:

* Detection of mutations on abl gene
* resistance to TKI medications
